The Catharsis difference

Built to engage, not lecture.

Since 2000, our educators have helped campuses, installations and workplaces have the conversations that matter most, with a judgment-free approach people remember.

Grounded in research.

Every program is informed by the latest peer-reviewed research in the field and updated every year.

  • Meets requirements for Title IX, VAWA and Campus SaVE Act
  • Internally and externally evaluated

Built to engage.

Humor, improvisation and real dialogue lower defenses, so people reflect, participate and rethink.

  • Interactive vignettes, not slide decks
  • Tailored to each audience's language

Delivered your way.

Bring our educators to your campus, meet live over Zoom, or roll out self-paced courses.

  • Live In-Person and Live Remote
  • Online, self-paced and WCAG accessible
